photos.c: John Thresher stands triumphant after winning the LONDON v MILAN 1500 metres in 3:46.7. The other athletes are (left to right) Rizzo (3:47.8),Somaggio (3:49.3) and Gowan (3:58.4).
Thresher leads Rizzo and Somaggio during the Milan 1500 mts in 1965. He won from Rizzo in 3:46.7
